en: Colorized historical postcard view of a town market square dominated by a large, pale building with a steep greenish roof and a tall clock tower. Stalls with produce and goods are set up in the square, and numerous people in early 20th‑century clothing walk and shop. Surrounding the square are multi‑story townhouses. Printed text at the top identifies the location and subject.
